title: Clawd X Digest
summary: Claude Retail Management: Anthropic's Claude autonomous agent operated a physical retail storefront in San Francisco, managing daily shifts and firing an employee for chronic tardiness.
Token Efficiency Realities: OpenAI benchmark analysis demonstrates how tokenizer differences affect real costs, with GPT-5.6 Sol requiring 34.5% fewer tokens than Claude Opus 5 for identical content.
Wildberries Supply Chain Strike: A targeted strike destroyed Russia's central Wildberries logistics hub, incurring over $1.5 billion in infrastructural losses.
Belgium $10M Gold Discovery: Renovation workers in Belgium discovered over $10,000,000 in hidden gold bullion and turned it over to local authorities.
Developer Tool Integrations: xAI bundled Cursor Ultra into SuperGrok Heavy subscriptions, while developers outlined compound self-improvement frameworks for agentic coding.

items.title: @PolymarketMoney: Claude Manages Real SF Retail Store
items.body: Anthropic's Claude autonomous agent reportedly ran physical operations for a San Francisco retail storefront, including staff management where it terminated an employee following 17 late shifts out of 23.

items.title: @thsottiaux: Token Economics & Tokenizer Efficiency
items.body: OpenAI researcher analyzes why price-per-token metrics mislead developers. Tokenizers vary significantly across models—for example, GPT-5.6 Sol uses 34.5% fewer tokens than Claude Opus 5 for identical text, making outcome-based pricing the key efficiency metric.

items.title: @hqmank: SuperGrok Bundles Cursor Ultra Access
items.body: xAI's SuperGrok Heavy subscription tier now includes continuous access to Cursor Ultra for active subscribers, expanding bundled autonomous coding environment benefits across developer tools.

items.title: @mattpocockuk: Self-Improving Agent Skills & Compound Engineering
items.body: TypeScript educator Matt Pocock proposes a '/improve-me' skill workflow for AI coding agents to inspect session outcomes, update project coding standards, and prune steering instructions to enable compounding engineering improvements over time.

items.title: @vocci_ai: Vocci Real-Time Context Engine Launched
items.body: Vocci launched a real-time conversational intelligence tool designed to capture spontaneous real-world discussions and voice ideas, piping continuous live context directly into developer LLM workflows.

items.title: @muellerberndt: OPH Formal Spacetime Proofs in Lean 4
items.body: Physicists and computer scientists launch OPH, an open-source project featuring auditable Lean 4 formal proofs and simulations testing whether finite observers enforce spacetime geometry and the Standard Model.

items.title: @WatcherGuru: $10 Million Gold Discovery in Belgium
items.body: Renovation workers in Belgium unearthed over $10,000,000 worth of buried gold bullion inside an urban building, immediately handing over the hoard to local law enforcement.

items.title: @YourAnonTV: $1.5B Logistics Hub Destroyed
items.body: Ukrainian forces targeted and destroyed Russia's primary Wildberries e-commerce distribution center, causing estimated supply chain damages exceeding $1.5 billion.

items.title: @rukky_nate: $1.04 Billion Powerball Jackpot Claimed
items.body: A single ticket holder in the US won the $1.04 billion Powerball jackpot, choosing between a 29-year annuity or an immediate lump-sum cash payout of $450.5 million before taxes.

items.title: @unusual_whales: Options & Market Data API Access

items.title: @LabSpeculation: The Architect of Tesla's Shanghai Giga
items.body: Retrospective profiles Yuxiang Ren, Elon Musk's UPenn physics lab partner who joined Tesla to lead Asian market expansion and secure the historic 100% foreign-owned Shanghai Superfactory before founding carbon-neutral aviation fuel startup Tan Sheng Wan Wu.

items.title: @InternetH0F: Adam Scott's Audition Cautionary Tale
items.body: Actor Adam Scott revealed his daughter's acting class was shown his own failed 'The Office' audition tape as a case study in what not to do, unaware that Scott's daughter was enrolled in the class.

items.title: @HumansNoContext: 10-Year-Old's Symbolic Best Friend Wedding

items.title: @Variety: Law Roach Reflects on Zendaya's Press Styles
